description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2152/32 of 05.12.2019	(Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content is an Order issued under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011, which amends a previous gazette notification. It contains regulatory changes to import levies, specifically exempting certain raw materials for pharmaceutical manufacturers. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory amendments to existing legislation.
